audit.whatIsWrong: Two places tell the player to Wind Wall the charged Decimating Smash (Q).
audit.why: Q is a charged melee swing in an area in front of Sion — no projectile flag. Roar of the Slayer (E) is his only projectile and Wind Wall does eat it. The mirror audit made the identical correction from Sion's side.
audit.corrected: Sidestep the Q swing with Sweeping Blade; hold Wind Wall for Roar of the Slayer (12s at rank 1).

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3] says to 'R off his own or an ally's knock-up'.
audit.why: Last Breath blinks to an AIRBORNE ENEMY champion. Sion knocking YOU up gives you nothing — only an ally's knockup on Sion, or your own Q2 tornado, arms the ult.
audit.corrected: His knockups on you are not Last Breath fuel; make your own with the two-stack tornado.

audit.whatIsWrong: Glory in Death is never mentioned, and neither is Soul Furnace's percent-health detonation.
audit.why: The missing-interactions file flags both: Sion's post-death form heals off rapid attacks (Grievous Wounds timing decides those fights), and his W plus passive deal max-health damage, so raw armour stacking is the wrong answer.
audit.corrected: Carry Grievous Wounds for the reanimation; do not try to out-tank a percent-health shield detonation.

audit.why: Decimating Smash 10s at rank 1 to 6s, Soul Furnace 15s at rank 1, Roar of the Slayer 12s at rank 1, Unstoppable Onslaught 140/100/60s.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns and the level 3-5 spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four rows read Sion while their matching whys explain a Yasuo win.
audit.why: win[1] read 'Sion' beside 'your burst outpaces his weak early autos'. The packet levelChart reads Yasuo through the first item, and the mirror set the 2+ item row to Yasuo.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 3, first item and 2+ items set to Yasuo in matched pairs; levels 4-5 and level 6 left as Skill with whys rewritten to actually read even.

edits.before: Level 3 you sidestep or Wind Wall his charged Q and control every trade.
edits.after: At level 3 you sidestep his charged Q; the wall only stops his E.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 his knock-up windows are easy to dodge with E resets.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 hinge on whether you dodge the charged Q knockup.

edits.before: At 6 your R all-in outclasses a Sion with no burst of his own.
edits.after: At 6 neither kills cleanly — he stalls, you cannot burst a tank.

edits.before: Late game is skill-dependent — his hard-engage knock-ups threaten a clipped Yasuo.
edits.after: Late your crit DPS beats a tank whose engage you see coming a mile off.

edits.before: You dominate the trade: E-Q around his slow, telegraphed kit and punish every whiffed Decimating Smash (Q). His charged Q is the whole threat — sidestep the swing with E, or better, Wind Wall it if he times it as ranged, and he's left with only weak autos to trade back.
edits.after: You dominate the trade: E-Q around his slow kit and punish every whiffed Decimating Smash (Q). The charged Q is a melee swing, so no wall stops it — sidestep it with E and save Wind Wall for Roar of the Slayer (E, 12s at rank 1), the one projectile he owns.

edits.before: IE/Shieldbow online means your crits shred his tank stats, and Windwall neutralizes his ranged Roar (E). Keep freezing or shoving on your terms; he can't contest CS without walking into your E-Q, and his roams are slow and easy to track.
edits.after: IE/Shieldbow online means your crits shred his tank stats, and Wind Wall neutralizes his ranged Roar (E). Carry Grievous Wounds for Glory in Death — his post-death form heals off every rapid attack and steals fights he already lost.

edits.before: Skill-dependent late: Sion becomes a hard engage tank whose Q knock-up and ult can flip a fight if you get clipped. Windwall his E, save E to dodge his charged Q and R, and R off his own or an ally's knock-up. Positioning decides it, not raw lane strength.
edits.after: Skill-dependent late: Sion is a hard-engage tank whose Q knockup and ult flip a fight if you get clipped. Wind Wall the Roar, sidestep the charged Q, and note that Last Breath fires only on an airborne enemy — his knockups on you give you nothing.

edits.before: Late turns skill-dependent: Sion is a hard-engage tank whose Q and R can flip a fight, so Windwall his E, dodge his charges, and win through clean positioning.
edits.after: Late turns on positioning: Sion's Q and R flip a fight if they clip you, so Wind Wall the Roar, dodge the charged swing, and cut perpendicular to his ult.

edits.before: Sidestep or Wind Wall his charged Decimating Smash (Q)
edits.after: Sidestep Decimating Smash (Q) and wall Roar (E) instead

edits.before: - Sion Decimating Smash: matchup-defining — Charged = knockup. Dodge with E. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Decimating Smash: 10s at rank 1 — a melee swing, so sidestep it; no wall stops it. - Roar of the Slayer: 12s at rank 1, his only projectile, and Wind Wall eats it. - Unstoppable Onslaught: 140s at rank 1.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Soul Furnace shields him, then detonates for percent health.

edits.before: Track Sion's Decimating Smash (Stun): Charged = knockup. Dodge with E. When it is down — EQ-R him.
edits.after: Wind Wall stops Roar of the Slayer, never the charged Q swing — sidestep that one with E.

notes: The mirror reports that the Sion-side full layer still carries 'Yasuo Decimating Smash' (Sion's own Q printed as the tracked enemy ability) in winCon and other fields it could not reach. On this side focus.text correctly reads 'Sion Decimating Smash'. One thing I could not fit inside the length band: Roar of the Slayer also reduces armour on hit, which is why eating it before a trade is worse than it looks — worth adding if a field ever gains room.
